boxes.desc: General Q&A about ThaiJO and TCI on the website and LINE OA, answered from manuals and announcements, with no access to research content

boxes.title: Editor Console · OJS plugin
boxes.desc: Tool panel on the OJS submission page: check references, find reviewers, check similarity

boxes.title: AI Agent Orchestrator
bullets: Planning · break the question into subtasks
Routing · choose the right Skill, MCP or Subagent
Subagents · run subtasks in parallel, such as search and reference checks
Re-planning · adjust the plan when results are incomplete or fail
Synthesis · combine results into a cited answer
Memory · retain user and session context
Human-in-the-loop · the editor makes the final decision

boxes.title: LLM Router
boxes.desc: Pathumma LLM (NECTEC), Typhoon (SCB 10X), OpenThaiGPT and international models, chosen by task, cost and data requirements

boxes.title: TCI MCP Gateway & Registry
bullets: Registry · discovery, versioning and schemas for every MCP / Skill / API (A2A support for connecting external agents)
Access control · OAuth 2.1, ThaiJO SSO and role-based permissions for authors / editors / reviewers
Protocol bridge · MCP ↔ OJS REST API, OAI-PMH
Rate limiting · caching · per-journal audit logs

boxes.title: + Register
